# Convex agent skills attribution

Optional local Convex skills under `.agents/skills/convex/`, `.agents/skills/convex-*/`
(except `convex-hackathon-skill`) and `.claude/skills/` were installed by
`npx convex ai-files install` from [get-convex/agent-skills](https://github.com/get-convex/agent-skills).

- Source revision: `c41ece22681a50d326e54f30d24148a6d46d0c3c`.
- Installation paths and hashes: local, ignored `skills-lock.json`; the original tracked record remains in Git history before the repository cleanup.
- Upstream license: [Apache 2.0](LICENSE), preserved without modification.
- Icon attribution: [upstream third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md), preserved without modification.

The installed skills remain local and are no longer distributed in the current
source tree. These notices preserve the attribution of earlier tracked copies;
the tools are not required to build Surtario.

These notices apply to the copied skills and their assets. They do not assign a
license to the restaurant-procurement application. Separately installed design,
Firecrawl and Convex hackathon skills retain their own licenses and source
records in their local directories and earlier Git versions.
